name: Cleopatra
subtitle: Queen of the Nile
description: Boosts ally speed and sustains the vitality of your team
lore: Perhaps the most famous of Aaru’s queens, Cleopatra is underestimated by many who attribute her success to beauty and wiles. In fact, she is a clever politician and a brilliant tactician. Cleopatra orchestrates much of Aaru’s military defense today, though some nobles and generals still mistrust her due to her foreign heritage, a prejudice that weakens the realm’s war effort.
divinity_generator: Gain [30] when when inflicting a damage to an enemy

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +25%, Weapon Multiplier +15%, Armor Multiplier +15%

skills.name: Soothing Sands
skills.description: Heal all allies and restore 10% of their Destroyed MAX HP.

skills.name: Royal Mandate
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 2 times. Each hit increases the turn meter of all allies by 3%.

skills.name: Viper's Antidote
skills.description: Revive 1 ally with 30% HP and Turn Meter then attack all enemies. Also place [mechanic:res-up-ii] on all allies for 2 turns.
skills.awakening_bonus: The [RES Up II] cannot be removed.

skills.name: Nile's Blessing
skills.description: When a [Buff] on an ally expires or is removed, restore 5% of their Destroyed MAX HP

imprint_passive: When a [Buff] on an ally expires or is removed, restore 2.5% of their Destroyed MAX HP
